load_failed: Couldn't read the session triage switches: {error}
unsupported: This hub doesn't support session triage yet. Update the hub, then come back here.
title: Session triage
footer: Each time an agent stops, the hub reads its last reply with the triage model (once per turn, using the model you chose in {model}). Auto-continue and scheduled wake-ups run another turn on the agent's own model. The hub only asks you about things like pushing code, deploying or messaging other people; it never does them itself.
enabled_hint: Shows what each agent is waiting for; finished ones no longer count as Unread
decide_hint: When an agent waits for your call, its question and options go to Needs you
auto_continue_hint: Sends "continue" after a temporary model error (503 and the like), up to 3 times
wake_hint: Agents waiting on a deploy, CI or another agent get woken up to check for themselves
tool_loop_hint: Ask whether to interrupt when an agent appears stuck repeating tool calls
reply_reminder: Remind me when I haven't replied
reply_reminder_hint: If an agent asked you something and you still haven't replied {minutes} minutes after seeing it, you get one reminder. Rule-based, no tokens used
closeout_hint: When an agent stops after doing work without saying whether it's done, merged and deployed, and what's missing, its stop is held once to ask for that record. Costs one short extra turn on the agent's model
closeout_ask_hint: When an agent that nobody supervises stops after doing work, without a closeout and without being clearly finished, Persona asks it once for a status report on the work already done. Costs one turn on the agent's model
